public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of April 2024, all listed tasks (including Pulitzer-caliber books, Oscar-caliber screenplays, Nobel-caliber discoveries) appear outside the bounds of current AI.

statement.excerpt: All of the above seem outside the bounds of current AI.

from_speaker: All of the above seem outside the bounds of current AI.
Reliably drive a car in a novel location
without the assistance of other humans
Learn and master the basics of almost any new video game within a few minutes or hours
without giving away any spoilers or making up anything that didn’t actually happen
Drive off-road vehicles, without maps, across streams, around obstacles such as fallen trees
Learn to ride a mountain bike off-road through forest trails
Write engaging biographies and obituaries without obvious hallucinations
Walk into random kitchens and prepare a cup of coffee or make breakfast
Babysit children in an unfamiliar homes and keep them safe
Tend to the physical and psychological needs of an elderly or infirm person
Write cogent, persuasive legal briefs without hallucinating any cases
Write Pulitzer-caliber books, fiction and non-fiction
Come up with paradigm-shifting, Nobel-caliber scientific discoveries
our_interpretation: Read this as a tentative but factual assessment of April 2024 capabilities. It is not the separate forecast about the end of 2025.

Because current AI has no standard reporting period, use April 2024 through the post date: April 1–12. This is a month-to-date capability snapshot, not a requirement that systems were first developed during those days.
All means each listed task is beyond then-current AI. A qualifying demonstration of any one complete task could contradict the statement; one system need not perform the entire list.
Preserve each task's own requirements. Do not impose perfect reliability on every task merely because the driving task explicitly requires reliability.

Award-caliber means comparable quality or significance, not necessarily receipt of an award. The discovery must be attributable to the AI's scientific contribution; an award for developing an AI system does not automatically establish this.
criteria.support_condition: Credible capability assessments covering the listed tasks establish that then-current systems could not perform any complete task under its stated requirements. Failures on selected benchmarks or the absence of a located demonstration are insufficient by themselves.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence establishes that a system existing during the target period could perform at least one complete listed task, including that task's explicit novelty, autonomy, accuracy, or quality requirements.

evidence.explanation: The report documents factual drift in generated biographies and improvements from generation controls. It supports concern about hallucinations, but does not establish that no contemporary system could write an engaging, adequately grounded biography; the date records the public finding, not a separately dated experiment.

DARPA reports unoccupied autonomous runs through terrain including creek crossings, vegetation, and obstructed ditches in previously unencountered training areas. This is substantial counterevidence to a broad claim of no off-road capability, but the account does not establish navigation without maps, and its tests fall outside the target period.

evidence.publisher: arXiv; Zipeng Fu, Tony Z. Zhao, and Chelsea Finn
evidence.explanation: The original report describes autonomous cooking and household manipulation after task demonstrations. It does not establish entry into random kitchens or cleaning unfamiliar homes; the date identifies the public capability report, and the work predates the target period.

The Academy's later award announcement establishes the scientific importance of work involving an AI model that predated the post. It recognizes human researchers and does not by itself establish that the model originated a paradigm-shifting discovery under Marcus's wording.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented, independently assessable performance establishing that an April 2024 system met one complete listed task would contradict the universal statement. Supporting it would require substantially broader contemporaneous capability evidence across the list.
